items.html: The matter is that, just as all the aspects of the throat are doubled from Hochma, in the secret of a drop from above and drops from below, as mentioned, so too here it must be so, for there, in Hochma, was the final Yud-Hey-Vav, in which the others were included, in the secret of 42, as above. And here, in the throat, the two supernal names of Ehyeh, in which the lower ones are included, are, in gematria, only one 42, and they need to be two times 42, for the reason mentioned.
